'''Velvex''' is an Indian [[automotive]] [[lubricants]] and [[adBlue]] manufacturing company, headquartered in [[Mumbai]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=This Environment Day, VELVEX Drives the Future with Sustainable Packaging in the AdBlue Industry |url=https://www.tribuneindia.com/news/business/this-environment-day-velvex-drives-the-future-with-sustainable-packaging-in-the-adblue-industry/ |access-date=2026-02-20 |website=tribuneindia.com |publisher=[[The Tribune (India)]] |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Velvex Expands Lubricants & AdBlue Footprint at Excon 2025 – Motorindia |url=https://www.motorindiaonline.in/velvex-expands-lubricants-adblue-footprint-at-excon-2025/ |access-date=2026-02-20 |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Mumbai-based Nandan Petrochem eyes strong growth in lubricant, DEF demand |url=https://www.autocarpro.in/video/nandan-petrochem-eyes-strong-growth-in-lubricant-def-demand-124817 |access-date=2026-02-20 |website=autocarpro.in |publisher=[[Autocar (magazine)]] |language=en |archive-date=2025-07-15 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250715103344/https://www.autocarpro.in/video/nandan-petrochem-eyes-strong-growth-in-lubricant-def-demand-124817 |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Report |first=Staff |date=March 1, 2025 |title=Nandan Petrochem champions the sustainable production of VELVEX Oils |url=https://www.oemupdate.com/oil-lubricants/nandan-petrochem-champions-the-sustainable-production-of-velvex-oils/ |access-date=2026-02-20 |website=oemupdate.com |language=en-UK}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=This Environment Day, VELVEX Drives the Future with Sustainable Packaging in the AdBlue Industry |website=theprint.in |url=https://theprint.in/ani-press-releases/this-environment-day-velvex-drives-the-future-with-sustainable-packaging-in-the-adblue-industry/2646857/ |publisher=[[ThePrint]] }}</ref>
